team.text: The creators of Zensmith are two seasoned Project Managers with over three decades of experience in the corporate world.
The founders of Zensmith are Baby Boomers.
The founders of Zensmith experienced an unbalanced life due to excessive work hours.
The founders sought tools to improve their quality of life and manage the work-personal divide.
The founders tried various applications, including Gantt based PM apps, ToDo lists, Mindmaps, Group Collaboration Task Management Systems, KanBan boards, and Slack.
Four years ago, the founders met by chance and shared their experiences.
The founders became experts in 'human work activity' through their research.
In the context of a particular project, individuals play one defined operational role: Project Manager (PM), Team Member (TM), or Follower.
An individual can be involved in several projects at the same time and can play any of the defined roles.
